name: Necromancer: Skeletal Rogue attacks apply Decaying Poison up to 3 stacks (#6515, #6670)
contract: Raise: Skeletal Rogue 500969 summons creature 50078, whose passive 805023 gives its melee attacks a 40% chance to apply Decaying Poison 805024, stacking 3 times. Commanded onto a durable enemy, the rogue must poison it within half a minute. The poison lasts 6 seconds, so the test reads it while present rather than after the fight.

steps.label: CONTROL: the enemy is not poisoned yet
Fight the enemy too, so the rogue joins its owner's target
The rogue's attacks apply Decaying Poison, at most 3 stacks
